q: In which year was Swat fully merged into Pakistan?
facts: The princely state of Swat acceded to Pakistan in 1947 and was fully merged into Pakistan in 1969.

q: Who is the Governor of Sindh? (current affairs)
facts: Nehal Hashmi became Governor of Sindh on 13 March 2026, replacing Kamran Khan Tessori.

q: Rearrange PRAIS to form the name of a city.
facts: PRAIS rearranges to PARIS (the capital of France).

q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q5) If 12 is divided by 3, what is half of the result?
facts: 12 divided by 3 gives 4, and half of 4 is 2.
rel: Tip: first do the division, then take half of the answer.

q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q18) Which letter comes next: B, D, G, L, ?
facts: Positions are 2, 4, 7, 12 with differences 2, 3, 5, which are consecutive primes. The next prime is 7, so 12 + 7 = 19, which is S.
rel: Tip: if differences are not simple, check whether they are consecutive primes.

q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q21) Which letter comes next: B, D, G, L, ?
facts: Positions are 2, 4, 7, 12 with differences 2, 3, 5, which are consecutive primes. The next prime is 7, so 12 + 7 = 19, which is S.
rel: Tip: if differences are not simple, check whether they are consecutive primes.

q: (Forces Academy Test 15 · Q3) Which one of the following is different? A. PQO, B. KJL, C. UTV, D. SRT, E. FEG
facts: KJL, UTV, SRT and FEG each go one step back then two steps forward (-1, +2). PQO goes forward then back (+1, -2), so it is the odd one.
rel: Tip: write the step sizes between neighbouring letters, as in +1, -2, to spot the odd group.

q: (Forces Academy Test 15 · Q19) What number comes next in the series: 13, 8, 5, 3, 2, ?
facts: Each term is the sum of the next two terms (13 = 8 + 5, 8 = 5 + 3, 5 = 3 + 2, 3 = 2 + 1), so the next number is 1.
rel: Tip: a series that falls can be a Fibonacci series written in reverse.

q: (Forces Academy Academic · Exam World 25) On what date was the Objective Resolution passed by the Constituent Assembly?
facts: The Objective Resolution was moved by Liaquat Ali Khan on 7 March 1949 and passed by the Constituent Assembly on 12 March 1949.
rel: It became a preamble to the constitutions of Pakistan.

q: (Forces Academy Academic · Exam World 31) In which years was the first Indo-Pak war fought?
facts: The war began in October 1947 and the UN-brokered ceasefire took effect on 1 January 1949; it is usually called the 1947-48 war.
rel: Many books call it the 1947-48 war.

q: (Forces Academy Academic · Line 22) How many general seats did the Awami League win in the 1970 National Assembly election?
facts: The Awami League of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman won 160 general seats, all but two of East Pakistan's seats.
rel: Counting reserved women seats, its tally rose to 167 of 313 seats.

q: (Forces Academy Academic · Line 91) In which year was the Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental School upgraded to MAO College?
facts: Sir Syed Ahmad Khan began the school in 1875 and it was upgraded to MAO College in 1877.
rel: The college became Aligarh Muslim University in 1920.

q: Who was the first Chief Justice of Pakistan?
facts: Sir Abdul Rashid became the first Chief Justice of the Federal Court of Pakistan in 1949.
rel: Muhammad Munir succeeded him as Chief Justice in 1954.

q: Rearrange the letters PEOLARD to form a correct English word.
facts: The letters P, E, O, L, A, R, D rearrange to make LEOPARD, a big cat.
rel: The leopard is a big cat found in Africa and Asia, and it is a strong climber.

q: In which year was the Baghdad Pact (later renamed CENTO) signed?
facts: The Baghdad Pact was signed in 1955 and was renamed CENTO in 1959 after Iraq withdrew.
rel: Pakistan was a member of both CENTO and SEATO.

q: What is the motto given by the Quaid-e-Azam to the nation?
facts: The Quaid-e-Azam gave the nation the motto Unity, Faith, Discipline (Ittehad, Yaqeen-e-Muhkam, Nazm). This is the order used in his speeches and in Pakistani textbooks.
rel: In Urdu the motto is often written as Ittehad, Tanzeem, Yaqeen-e-Muhkam; Unity, Faith, Discipline is the standard English form.

q: Sindhi belongs to which language family?
facts: Sindhi is an Indo-Aryan language that developed from Sanskrit and Prakrit.
rel: Sindhi is the official language of Sindh province and is written in a Perso-Arabic script.

q: Rearrange the letters E T W A R to make a word. What is the second last letter of that word?
facts: The letters form the word WATER. Its letters are W, A, T, E, R so the second last letter is E.
rel: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, and its formula is H2O.

q: Vehicle is to road as ship is to ___ ?
facts: A vehicle travels on a road, and a ship travels on the sea. The analogy links a vehicle or vessel with the surface it moves on.
rel: Analogy questions: find the relationship in the first pair and apply it to the second.

q: Which is the longest river of India?
facts: The Ganga is the longest river of India, about 2,525 km.
rel: The Indus and Brahmaputra are longer overall but rise outside India.

q: Complete the sentence: Our team ______ their track suits.
facts: "Their" is plural, so the team is treated as a group of members and the plural verb "are wearing" agrees with it.
rel: In British English a collective noun like team can take a plural verb when the members act individually.

q: Car is to wheel as clock is to what?
facts: A wheel is a part of a car, and hands are a part of a clock.
rel: Analogy questions: find the relationship in the first pair and apply it to the second.

q: Aliza is 12 years older than Asad. When Asad was 6, Aliza was 3 times his age. How old will Aliza be when Asad is 14?
facts: When Asad was 6, Aliza was 3 x 6 = 18, so the gap is 18 - 6 = 12 years, which never changes. When Asad is 14, Aliza is 14 + 12 = 26.
rel: The age gap between two people stays the same all their lives.

q: Vehicle is to wheels as clock is to what?
facts: Wheels are a part of a vehicle, and hands are a part of a clock.
rel: Analogy questions: find the relationship in the first pair and apply it to the second.

q: After arranging the letters of SIRAP, it becomes the name of a country, city, ocean or state. Which one is it?
facts: The letters of SIRAP rearrange to PARIS, the capital city of France. So it is a city.
rel: Anagram questions: look for a familiar name first, then check that every letter is used.
